name: lazyfox
description: Keyboard-first, UI-free Firefox. Leader-key navigation, paginated which-key overlay, centered search, tab switcher and link hints.

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.scripts.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.e2e.json --noEmit && npm --prefix installer/frontend run typecheck
scripts.test: npm run test:go && npm run test:unit && npm run test:wire && npm run test:seam && npm run test:legacy && node scripts/check-dist.ts && node scripts/check-installer-payload.ts
scripts.test:go: go test ./core/ && go test -C native-host ./... && npm run test:installer
scripts.test:legacy: node --experimental-strip-types --import ./scripts/test/_loader.mjs scripts/test-chrome-keys.ts && node --experimental-strip-types --import ./scripts/test/_loader.mjs scripts/test-store.ts && node --experimental-strip-types --import ./scripts/test/_loader.mjs scripts/test-render-escaping.ts && node --experimental-strip-types --import ./scripts/test/_loader.mjs scripts/test-overlays.ts && node --experimental-strip-types --import ./scripts/test/_loader.mjs scripts/test-observability.ts && node --experimental-strip-types --import ./scripts/test/_loader.mjs scripts/test-leader-sequences.ts && node --experimental-strip-types --import ./scripts/test/_loader.mjs scripts/test-history-related.ts && node --experimental-strip-types --import ./scripts/test/_loader.mjs scripts/test-dev-helpers.ts && node --experimental-strip-types --import ./scripts/test/_loader.mjs scripts/test-page-text.ts && node --experimental-strip-types --import ./scripts/test/_loader.mjs scripts/test-find-text.ts && node --experimental-strip-types --import ./scripts/test/_loader.mjs scripts/test-payload.ts && node --experimental-strip-types --import ./scripts/test/_loader.mjs scripts/test-installer.ts
